name: BD KINGS LANES BAR AND GRILL

violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bags of food in prep freezer.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Observed torn seal on prep freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed dried food in microwave. -Observed inside of refrigerators and freezers need to be cleaned.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Observed empty container in hand sink at time of inspection.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Working container holding food item was not labeled properly to identify contents. - Several containers in the fridges need to be dated and labeled.
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. - Kitchen equipment in need of more thorough cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Kitchen in need of more thorough cleaning along floor edging and under equipment.
